reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: MFM-220 evolves under electrochemical potential; the pristine framework must not be treated automatically as the proven active phase.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: Use MFM-220-p as the operational catalyst identity unless active-phase assignment is independently confirmed.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: The accessible source describes TAL-33 as a precursor and attributes catalytic activity to metallic Bi sites after conversion.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: Treat this as a MOF-derived catalyst record, not as evidence that pristine TAL-33 is the active phase.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: The reported electrocatalyst is a MOF-derived bismuth nanosheet array rather than the pristine precursor framework.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: Use Bi/CC-17 as a derived-material identity; do not transfer its metrics to the precursor MOF.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: MOF conversion yields leafy Bi nanosheets with a hybrid Bi/Bi-O interface associated with activity.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: Performance metrics belong to the derived Bi/Bi-O nanosheets, not pristine CAU-17.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: The Bi(btb) precatalyst restructures to Bi nanoparticles embedded in a porous organic matrix.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: Use the restructured Bi nanoparticle material as the catalytic identity; pristine Bi(btb) is a precatalyst.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: Thiol-laced Zr-DMBD confines Bi nanoparticles while post-catalysis characterization indicates partial surface decomposition and retained bulk stabilization.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: The composite and its post-reaction surface state must remain distinct from pristine Zr-DMBD.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: Unsaturated Bi sites in conductive Bi-HHTP are proposed as active centers for a COOH-mediated formate route.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: The unsaturated-Bi assignment is evidence-supported but remains tied to the reported operando/computational interpretation.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: SU-101 nanorods are reported as the electrocatalyst; DFT supports formate selectivity relative to HER.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: The accessible evidence supports a framework-level catalyst assignment but does not replace operando active-phase verification.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: A Bi2CuO4 interfacial structure is associated with the MOF-derived catalyst and an HCOO-mediated pathway.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: The catalytic record belongs to the derived CuBi/Bi2CuO4 material, not pristine CuBi-MOF.

reactionRecords.activePhaseClaim: The source reports a highly stable two-dimensional porous Bi-MOF electrocatalyst.
reactionRecords.activePhaseBoundary: No stronger active-site claim is stored without additional operando or post-reaction structural evidence.
